bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; appropriating money to promote shooting sports for persons with a disability.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; FORGOTTEN HEROES RANGES AND RETREAT.

$50,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of natural resources for a grant to the Forgotten Heroes Ranges and Retreat to promote shooting sports for persons with a disability and to host a persons with a disability shooting day.
